result.summary: The page is a food delivery home screen that is mostly well-rendered. One clear defect was found: the Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed number computation leaking into the UI.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, exposing a JavaScript NaN value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Guard the delivery fee formatting against undefined/null/non-numeric values; fall back to a valid price (e.g. '€0 delivery' or 'Free delivery') or hide the fee line when the value is unavailable, and fix the upstream data mapping that produces the non-numeric value.
